_doc: Recorded upstream cel-spec vendor revision as of the last refresh. The drift checker (scripts/check-cel-spec-drift.py) maps every vendored cel_spec_vectors.json vector to a corpus case in tests/conformance/cel/relay_cel_corpus.json and asserts the mapping holds. The legacy upstream-package-pin comparison (cel-python / cel-js lower bounds) was REMOVED in M6: both CEL libraries were deleted in the single-engine WASM cutover, so there is no upstream CEL package version to pin here anymore -- the sole CEL engine is the pinned relay_cel_wasm artifact. Bumping the vendored cel-spec revision (vendored_cel_spec_revision) still requires refreshing cel_spec_vectors.json and bumping last_refreshed_at.
